name: @pi-in-go/pigpen-pig-hermes-core
description: Shared pure-Go library for pig-hermes and derived Piglets (such as oh-my-hermes-pig): Hermes path/profile resolution, config.yaml/.env loader, MEMORY.md/USER.md store and MemoryProvider interface, delegation RouteResolver, unified todo store, usage ledger, EventBus channel constants, and composable clihook dispatcher
author: Michael Kinsy
